title: Stop treating your prop eval like a live account
caption: The mindset shift Tradever's CEO teaches for prop evaluations. #tradever #propfirm #tradingtips #futurestrading #ad @tradeverfunding @laythbanks

slides.text: Treating your eval like a *live account*?
slides.sub: Layth calls it one of the most common prop firm mistakes.

slides.text: What you're trying to do is … figure out how fast you can make the profit target before you hit the max loss limit.
Treat these accounts like a business and an investment.
How fast can you make *$3,000* before you lose *$2,000* on a *50K* account?
slides.sub: The question he has his students ask.
